item.text: {"question_id":"6B.5","answer":"During 2023, Lula’s administration established or maintained several measurement and oversight arrangements: the annual national education census, MDS monitoring tools and targets, public beneficiary information, social-control councils, a federal Bolsa Família/CadÚnico inspection network, CadÚnico interoperability, and external scrutiny by the TCU and CGU (BATCH-0002-E004; BATCH-0020-E001; BATCH-0020-E002; BATCH-0019-E003; BATCH-0019-E005; BATCH-0015-E002). The TCU audits demonstrate that independent evaluation was permitted, including audits of CadÚnico, Bolsa Família targeting and budget execution (BATCH-0003-E008; BATCH-0003-E013; BATCH-0009-E011; BATCH-0009-E012). However, the supplied evidence does not establish that official welfare data were consistently credible or that findings were systematically used to correct failure. Audits identified substantial CadÚnico inconsistencies, estimated 2.2 million excess Bolsa Família recipient families, deficient regional coverage indicators, weak monitoring, and incomplete budget and operational reporting (BATCH-0003-E008; BATCH-0003-E013; BATCH-0005-E003; BATCH-0009-E012; BATCH-0019-E013). The administration undertook initial redesign and review measures for Bolsa Família and created a vaccination-monitoring coordination unit, but the sources do not demonstrate that these actions were completed corrections tied to evaluated failures or that they produced verified 2023 results (BATCH-0009-E008; BATCH-0016-E015). The TCU’s corrective orders and recommendations included deadlines extending through 2024 or later, with no supplied evidence of completion during the target period (BATCH-0003-E010; BATCH-0003-E013).","supporting_evidence_ids":["BATCH-0002-E004","BATCH-0020-E001","BATCH-0020-E002","BATCH-0019-E003","BATCH-0019-E005","BATCH-0015-E002","BATCH-0003-E008","BATCH-0003-E013","BATCH-0009-E011","BATCH-0009-E012","BATCH-0009-E008","BATCH-0016-E015"],"contrary_or_qualifying_evidence_ids":["BATCH-0003-E008","BATCH-0003-E013","BATCH-0005-E003","BATCH-0009-E012","BATCH-0019-E013","BATCH-0019-E005","BATCH-0003-E010","BATCH-0020-E001","BATCH-0020-E002"],"limitations_and_gaps":["The evidence establishes monitoring and audit architecture more clearly than credible completed welfare-data publication or independent program evaluation results.","Official dashboards contain planned targets and loading or non-2023 fields; supplied extracts do not provide verified 2023 outcome values.","Some adverse findings concern inherited systems, prior programs, or subnational execution, so personal presidential responsibility is indirect or unresolved.","The sources do not show completion of the ordered corrections within 2023 or demonstrate that redesigns were causally driven by evaluated failure.","The supplied evidence does not establish systematic personnel correction in response to welfare-program evidence."],"corrections_made":["Removed the unsupported characterization of the overall system as substantively credible or substantial in operation.","Recast the evidence as demonstrating formal measurement and permitted external audit, while withholding the stronger claim of credible data and completed correction.","Reclassified Bolsa Família redesign, vaccination coordination, and related actions as initial or potentially responsive measures without proof of completed, evaluation-driven correction.","Made data-quality, reporting, coverage, inherited-system, attribution, and post-2023 deadline limitations central to the answer."],"reasons_to_reopen_full_ledger":["Locate direct evidence of published 2023 welfare and service outcomes with validation or independent corroboration.","Verify whether TCU, CGU, or other audit recommendations were implemented during the defined ruler-period.","Assess whether Bolsa Família redesign and CadÚnico remediation were explicitly linked to diagnosed failures and whether results were measured.","Clarify any ruler-level direction or accountability for subnational and inherited administrative deficiencies."]}
